data.response:
**Pick Rossi Idraulica.** Cheaper with VAT included, double the warranty, and Marta already knows your system.

| | Rossi Idraulica | TermoCasa |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unit | Vaillant ecoTEC plus 30 kW | Baxi Duo-tec 28 kW |
| Total incl. VAT | **3,950 EUR** | 4,148 EUR |
| Warranty | 10 yr (yearly service required) | 5 yr |
| Can fit | In two weeks | Next week |

TermoCasa's 3,400 EUR headline is misleading: plus 22% VAT is 4,148 EUR, so Rossi is 198 EUR cheaper, not dearer. Rossi also includes removing the old unit; TermoCasa doesn't say.

Two caveats. Rossi's 10 year warranty only holds if it's serviced yearly, so ask what that costs and whether anyone qualified can do it, not just Rossi. And the earlier slot isn't worth much: your Vaillant still works, it just drops to 0.8 bar every two weeks, so two weeks is fine. Also skip the expansion vessel repair if you're replacing the boiler anyway.
